@chandani\_kumari5 Great question! Yes, quite a bit:

Turn any of the 14 tools on or off, so the panel only shows what you use

Pick which quick toggles appear (12 to choose from, like dark mode, keep awake, lock screen, hide desktop icons)

Set your own Pomodoro, break and timer lengths

Set your workday hours for the Day Progress bar

Adjust the hover delay, show or hide the tool dock, and switch to a glass look

Choose whether downloads land on the Shelf, and set your own Claude Code token budget

Hide it in full-screen apps, and keep it closed during video calls

The Launcher follows your Dock, so it always matches the apps you already use. [...] Why should the Mac s notch just take up space?

So I built 14 small tools around it to make the notch part of my everyday workflow - quick access, useful utilities, and a little personality.

Dashboard the home page, with the other tools condensed into cells. Cannot be switched off.

Today your calendar, with a one-click Join for Zoom, Meet and Teams.

Tasks a local to-do list with a quick-add field.

Reminders your Apple Reminders, tickable from the notch.

Notes multiple notes that save as you type.

Pomodoro work, break, long break, quick timer, custom and a stopwatch.

AI Usage live tokens, cost, burn rate and the five-hour window for Claude Code and Codex.
